name: Barbett Industries Inc

about:
Barbett Industries Inc. operates from Reading, Pennsylvania, where it has built a business around narrow-fabric manufacturing. The company is led by President Frank J. Loos and General Manager Joseph Loos, his son, indicating a family-led operation. No founding year is disclosed in public materials.

The firm produces a broad line of narrow textiles including twist cord, draw cord, lamp shade trim, Chinese braid, bolo cord, industrial braid, metallic braid, jacquard braids, shoelaces, boot laces, bullion fringe, soutache, and vellum braid. Finishing capabilities cover custom dyeing, acetate tipping, hot and cold cutting, metal barbing, cord and tassel assembly, textile crimping, and waxing. The company also replicates customer samples and provides production cost estimates, and it accepts customer-supplied goods for finishing work.

Barbett serves the apparel, military and uniform, home furnishings, industrial, fishing lure, and flag component markets. Its product categories also include braided vinyl and leather trims. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to uniform suppliers and specialty fabricators.

The company positions itself as an independent domestic source for both custom and commodity narrow fabrics, emphasizing competitive pricing and the ability to match customer samples. It highlights its willingness to process customer-owned materials through its finishing operations.
